marker_method: Use the pre-recorded buffer scheduling wall-time estimate plus the marker offset within that buffer. Casefold and ё/е normalization; exact complete-word sequence in records overlapping this time [-2,+12] seconds. Initial wall-clock plus nominal audio duration is invalid after accumulated AudioContext clock drift.
marker_limitation: An unrecognized keyword does not prove missing audio; inspect saved WebM and distinguish ASR substitutions from capture loss.
original_remaining: Real Zoom, minimum agreed hardware, independent human corpus, CPU stress and isolated nearly-full volume not tested.
phrase_latency_method: Conservative upper bound from chunk-end lag plus maximum decoded chunk duration; no word-level timing acceptance.
version_scope: Historical b501103 endurance baseline; excludes latest cooperative signal handlers and Linux parent-death guard. Latest lifecycle/recovery/normal checks are separate.

clock_alignment_correction.reason: The initial assessment added nominal audio duration to the first wall timestamp. Recorded buffer scheduling timestamps show accumulated AudioContext/wall-clock offset. Windows are now anchored to each pre-recorded buffer scheduling event; audio, expected keywords, source and ASR records were not changed.
